docs: Steps content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of two to six steps, each with a short label (01, 02), a title and a line. One object is valid in every steps layout (a row, a column).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

steps.docs: the steps, in the order they are taken

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

label.docs: the short marker of the step (01, 2, A)

description.docs: one line about the step; empty: none
